record.original_question: Do the symplectic and orthogonal squared-content sums both satisfy the content Nekrasov-Okounkov formula in Conjecture 6.3(a): Σ_{n≥0} x^n Σ_{λ⊢n} ∏_{u∈λ} (t + c_sp(u)^2)/h(u)^2 = Σ_{n≥0} x^n Σ_{λ⊢n} ∏_{u∈λ} (t + c_O(u)^2)/h(u)^2 = (∏_{j≥1} 1/(1 - x^{4j-2})) (∏_{j≥1} 1/(1-x^j)^t)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For an integer partition $\lambda$ of $n$, write $\lambda \vdash n$ and view $\lambda$ as a Young diagram. For a cell $u=(i,j)\in\lambda$ (with $i$ the row index and $j$ the column index, both starting at $1$), let:
- $h(u)$ denote the hook length of $u$ in $\lambda$,
- $c(u)=j-i$ denote the (ordinary) content of $u$,
- $c_{\mathrm{sp}}(u)$ denote the symplectic content of $u$, defined by
$$c_{\mathrm{sp}}(u)=\begin{cases} \lambda_i+\lambda_j-i-j+1, & i\le j,\\ -(\lambda'_i+\lambda'_j-i-j+1), & i>j,\end{cases}$$
where $\lambda'$ is the conjugate partition,
- $c_{O}(u)$ denote the orthogonal content of $u$, defined by
$$c_{O}(u)=\begin{cases} \lambda_i+\lambda_j-i-j, & i< j,\\ -(\lambda'_i+\lambda'_j-i-j), & i\ge j.\end{cases}$$

Prove or disprove that, as formal power series in $x$ with coefficients in $\mathbb{Q}[t]$,
$$\sum_{n\ge 0}x^n\sum_{\lambda\vdash n}\prod_{u\in\lambda}\frac{t+c_{\mathrm{sp}}(u)^2}{h(u)^2}\;=\;\sum_{n\ge 0}x^n\sum_{\lambda\vdash n}\prod_{u\in\lambda}\frac{t+c_{O}(u)^2}{h(u)^2}\;=\;\Bigl(\prod_{j\ge 1}\frac{1}{1-x^{4j-2}}\Bigr)\Bigl(\prod_{j\ge 1}\frac{1}{(1-x^j)^t}\Bigr).$$
artifact.category_tag: Hook length formulas and partition identities
artifact.status_search_result: Special cases of Amdeberhan's conjectures on symplectic/orthogonal content Nekrasov–Okounkov formulas were established by Amdeberhan, Andrews, and Ballantine, and by Heim–Neuhauser. The general cases, including the symplectic/orthogonal content Nekrasov–Okounkov identity, are proved in Yang's 2025 paper "Hook-lengths, symplectic/orthogonal contents and Amdeberhan's conjectures" in the Proceedings of the London Mathematical Society.

status_evidence.title: Hook-lengths, symplectic/orthogonal contents and Amdeberhan's conjectures
status_evidence.snippet: Proves the general cases of Amdeberhan's conjectures on hook-lengths and symplectic/orthogonal contents.
status_evidence.claim: The symplectic/orthogonal content Nekrasov–Okounkov conjecture of Amdeberhan is proved in full generality.

status_evidence.title: On conjectures regarding the Nekrasov–Okounkov hook length formula
status_evidence.snippet: Examines and resolves cases of three conjectures of Amdeberhan related to hook-length and content formulas.
status_evidence.claim: Earlier partial progress on Amdeberhan's conjectures, including special cases of the symplectic/orthogonal identity.
